mechanisms.name: Perception: position/area via unit->path->room1->room2->level chain (C:\dev\d2go-local\pkg\memory\player.go, koolo-build\internal\game\memory_reader.go ReadLiveLevelFrame)
mechanisms.how: RPM walk of the proven pointer chain; positions at path+0x02/0x06, area at level+0x1F8, DrlgLevel frame at +0x24..0x30 (*5 to subtiles). Read ~3Hz.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE — the backbone; but reads during loading screens return garbage (main.go:945 waits for sane position; the 17 intermittent UnitTable pattern misses are load-screen dropouts self-healed by GetData's offset-recompute when UnitTable==0).

mechanisms.name: Perception: player Mode / monster Mode
mechanisms.how: playerUnit+0x0c; death = mode.Death/Dead (main.go:4371), gait = Running(3)/Walking(2) closed loop (ensureGait, main.go:650); monster death = NpcDeath/NpcDead in Enemies() filter (d2go-local\pkg\data\npc.go:61).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE — the honest death/gait channel on 3.2; replaced the frozen Life stat for monster death.

mechanisms.name: Perception: monster Life stat
mechanisms.how: getStatsList via statsListExPtr+0xA8; value >>8 for Life.
mechanisms.verdict: DEAD on 3.2 — frozen at 32768 (main.go:7905 comment). Yet still consulted: anyEnemyWithin gates on m.Stats[stat.Life] > 0 (main.go:659, vacuously true) and npc.go's Enemies() keeps the same vacuous clause. Harmless today only by accident.

mechanisms.name: Perception: player stats via BaseStats/Stats (HPPercent, MPPercent, StatPoints, gold, durability)
mechanisms.how: statsListExPtr+0x30 (base) and +0xA8 (modified); autostat verifies spend by StatPoints readback.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE for the player — the stat allocator and potion logic close their loops on it.

mechanisms.name: Perception: Skills map + LeftSkill/RightSkill selection
mechanisms.how: skill list walk at unit+0x100; selection at skillListPtr+0x08/0x10. Used to gate KeyBindings trust (main.go:564 bound()) and to close the loop on skill-select presses (main.go:7949 switch on RightSkill).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE — and the model for channel-gating: a binding is only believed when the Skills map confirms the skill exists.

mechanisms.name: Perception: HoverData (offset.Hover)
mechanisms.how: 12-byte read: IsHovered u16, UnitType at +4, UnitID at +8. The only honest 'will this click hit'. Asynchronous: ~1 frame latency, so hoverPickClick/interactNPC double-confirm by RE-AIMING the same point and re-reading (main.go:792, 858).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE for monsters, items, objects, corpse, entrances (UnitType 2/5), NPCs (UnitType 5, -hovergrid) — but only through the aim-settle-reaim ritual; a bare read after a sweep reflects the PRIOR cursor position.

mechanisms.name: Perception: Corpse unit (own body)
mechanisms.how: RawPlayerUnits GetCorpse: isCorpse byte at unit+0x1AE gated on inventory/pos != 0 (fix lives in d2go-local, not public repo). Corpse.Found only reads in the corpse's own area (main.go:4508), so death state (area+pos) persists to logs/death_state.txt across restarts.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE with a scope limit that is itself a measured law (cross-area corpse = blind hunt via nakedCorpseHunt).

mechanisms.name: Perception: KeyBindings block
mechanisms.how: Hardcoded module offsets 0x1DFFAF4 / 0x2228030 (d2go-local\pkg\memory\keybindings.go:11-12) — build-pinned, not pattern-scanned.
mechanisms.verdict: DEAD on the 3.2 repack — reads all-zero/stale ('the Life-stat disease', main.go:5237). Correctly quarantined at the combat layer (Skills-map gate; belt/hotkeys come from flags) but GetData still assembles it every tick and nothing marks it dead in code.

mechanisms.name: Perception: OpenMenus
mechanisms.how: Bit flags at UI base -0xA (game_reader.go:146).
mechanisms.verdict: DEAD — 'stable garbage' on 3.2 (main.go:3409). Replaced by the measured UIBytes[0xF4] menu byte, found by diffing user-produced open/closed snapshots (main.go:4932-4941). Still computed and returned in every GetData.

mechanisms.name: Perception: UIBytes menu byte at 0xF4
mechanisms.how: gr.UIBytes() returns a 0x400 window around the pattern-scanned UI base; byte 0xF4 == 1 means a dialog/menu is open; polled with a 1.2s deadline instead of sleeping blind.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE — the honest panel-open oracle; the rest of the block is deliberate offset-archaeology space.

mechanisms.name: Perception: the five PATTERN NOT FOUND offsets at attach (GameData, Expansion, Roster, WidgetStates, Waypoints)
mechanisms.how: d2go calculateOffsets (offset.go): FindPattern prints to stderr and returns 0 on miss; the arithmetic then continues from pattern=0, producing plausible-looking garbage offsets. Confirmed in logs: 112 attaches x 5 misses; UnitTable additionally misses ~17x during loads.
mechanisms.verdict: DEAD-BUT-CONSUMED — Roster is read through a garbage pointer every GetData; WidgetStates makes GetActiveWeaponSlot junk (weapon-swap detection is fiction); Waypoints makes AvailableWaypoints fiction; Expansion garbage silently flips isMainPlayer to the +0x30 fallback which happens to work offline; GameData has zero consumers (pure noise). No failure semantics anywhere — 'ignoring errors, always best practices' (offset.go:21).

mechanisms.name: Perception: live Room2 graph (roomgraph.go)
mechanisms.how: Enumerate current level's Room2 list; cross-level neighbors = borders; Room1Ptr==0 marks unstreamed rooms. AdjacentLevels borders exist only for STREAMED rooms — a far border yields nothing until rooms load (main.go:7030).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE, partial-by-design — the frontier-advance pattern (walk toward known-touching-unknown) is the correct response, encoded in Atlas.FrontierNear.

mechanisms.name: Perception: koolo-map prior (map_client + tools/koolo-map.exe)
mechanisms.how: Seed-deterministic world generation, cached per seed (memory_reader.go:62 seed cache fix). Known liars: some area grids arrive AXIS-TRANSPOSED (buildMapNavi scores all 4 transpose variants against live collision, accepts only >0.65 agreement, main.go:1597); mapped exits lie by ~30 subtiles; town collision omits the mod's fences entirely.
mechanisms.verdict: PRIOR-ONLY — trustworthy exclusively after live-collision validation; the transpose scoring and exit ring-search are the required admission tests.

mechanisms.name: Perception: Atlas (internal\game\atlas.go)
mechanisms.how: Persistent per-(seed,area) collision accumulated from live rooms masked to Room1Ptr!=0; atlasRefused is sticky actuation-truth (game refused passage the grid claimed walkable) that MergeLiveGrid never overwrites.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN — the reference design for recording truth: observed > prior, refusals are permanent evidence.

mechanisms.name: Perception: Objects/Entrances from the live unit table
mechanisms.how: UnitTable + 2*1024 / entrances; merged with map-data objects for far things (memory_reader.go GetData).
mechanisms.verdict: MIXED — positions live; Selectable flag LIES on 3.2 (Den stairs object 37, main.go:7180); statics with id=0 ignore all synthetic clicks (the static-click law, main.go:4804, overnight.sh fences); entrance units sometimes simply absent near a real exit (contact-push + hover-spiral fallback at main.go:7167-7233 is the honest workaround).

mechanisms.name: Perception: process liveness (StatusGameGone)
mechanisms.how: A dead D2R reads back all-zeros through RPM — indistinguishable from HP=0. GetExitCodeProcess is the only honest source (main.go:157-161).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN LAW — crash != death; every postmortem before it started from a false premise.

mechanisms.name: Perception: Screenshot (PrintWindow at physical pixels)
mechanisms.how: internal\game\screenshot.go captures at GameAreaSize*physicalScale (logical-size capture silently crops right/bottom). Feeds panelLitRow blueness (WP panel truth), bigLeftChange (shop-open verdict), and all calibration probes.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-LIVE — the court of appeal when memory channels are dead; pixel oracles verified panels the OpenMenus bits could not.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: GetPhysicalCursorPos stub patch (OverridePhysicalCursorPos)
mechanisms.how: 16-byte stub, imm64 X|Y updated by ONE atomic 8-byte data write on the hot path; stubIntact re-reads target bytes before any partial write (never trusts a cached flag). ALIASING LAW: GetCursorPos == GetPhysicalCursorPos on this build (one address); MovePointer only writes the legacy stub when exports differ (mouse.go:57).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN — the aquarium aim primitive: works unfocused, no real cursor, no driver. World aim = client*dpiscale, CLAMPED in-window (off-window cursor is DISCARDED by the game); panels use raw physical = origin*scale + UNSCALED client. Two separate measured spaces.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: keystate stubs (OverrideGetKeyState/GetAsyncKeyState, 2-key variant)
mechanisms.how: Resident cmp-cl stub installed once; hot path pokes the compare byte atomically; 0xFF disables. D2R POLLS GetKeyState — force-move, left-clicks, and menu arrow keys are all deaf without the override; the 2-key stub covers modified clicks (ctrl+click).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN — works unfocused; the 'game polls, messages alone are deaf' law is load-bearing for every click and key primitive.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: window-message clicks (SendMessage WM_LBUTTONDOWN/UP + VK override)
mechanisms.how: interactClick (world), uiClick (panel, client-coord lParam — panels hit-test off lParam, world ignores it), hoverPickClick's LeftClickNoMove. WORLD right-clicks work message-only; PANEL right-clicks are DEAF under every override tried (idkey/cubekey flag text, main.go:3074, 5015 — the identify flow pivots to world-right-click + panel-left-click because of it).
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN for left/world-right; REFUTED for panel-right. HAZARD: SendMessage BLOCKS forever against a frozen D2R — the sync hover was deleted for this exact reason (mouse.go:196-201) yet Click/LeftClickNoMove/LeftClickNoMoveClient still ride SendMessage; a wedged game hangs the bot mid-run holding patches (papered over by overnight.sh's timeout 960).

mechanisms.name: Actuation: force-move locomotion (walkToHold + Mover)
mechanisms.how: Key-state override + persistent KEYDOWN with dead-man timer release; re-aim while held; every non-walk input calls moveStop() first. LAW: D2R samples direction at the force-move KEY-DOWN EDGE — release->aim->press per stride (commit 2ea5d82, main.go:6973). Mover owns progress clocks: 5s physical stall, 12s no-closest-approach, planner flip, openBurst, then MoveBlocked to the caller.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN — the movelab-measured winner (16.5s/0.98 efficiency); the progress-clock and key-edge laws are non-negotiable survivors.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: click-move gait (D2R's own pathfinder via ground click)
mechanisms.how: mover.SetClickMove(interactClick); fires when carrot >= 10 tiles, rate-limited 1.6s.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN-THIN — refuted 1/4 pre-DPI-fix, retested 2/2 post-fix (main.go:4813). Correct conclusion, but the evidence base is two samples; keep only with its closed loop.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: SendInput / real OS input (sendinput.go)
mechanisms.how: Normalized absolute coords; delivers only to the FOREGROUND window; needed solely for D2R's front-end menus which ignore window messages.
mechanisms.verdict: WORKS-WITH-FOCUS — violates the aquarium if used in-game; quarantine to menu recovery with an explicit foreground step.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: Interception driver + -realcursor + hwbp findWriter
mechanisms.how: Driver-level strokes (real HID), SetCursorPos drive, and a hardware-breakpoint debugger session respectively.
mechanisms.verdict: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY / RULED-OUT — all three move real input or risk Arxan ('no debugger ever' vs hwbp.go's safety claim is an unresolved contradiction); HANDOFF §8 already sentenced -realcursor/-hwmove to deletion, yet they remain reachable from walkToHold.

mechanisms.name: Actuation: input heal discipline (HealInput/-fixinput/ResumeAllThreads)
mechanisms.how: Pristine bytes copied from our own user32 (same image base across processes) over all 8 input fns; unconditional on Unload; verifyRestore reads back; ResumeAllThreads clears leaked suspends. ONE farmbot at a time (probes included) because heal destroys a live bot's stubs; stubIntact downgrades that collision from AV to reinstall.
mechanisms.verdict: PROVEN recovery — but the one-instance rule is enforced only by shell-script convention and docs, not by any OS-level mutex; and the signal-handler Unload races the loop's writes (HANDOFF §7.4, known unfixed).

rootDefects.defect: Channel truth status is folklore, not code: there is no epistemics layer. Which memory reads are live, dead, frozen, or lying on this repack exists only as comments and flag help-text scattered through 8,096 lines of main.go and two handoff docs.
rootDefects.evidence: Life-frozen documented at main.go:7905 yet anyEnemyWithin still gates on m.Stats[stat.Life] > 0 (main.go:659); KeyBindings declared 'stale, never trust' (main.go:1300) yet deriveCombat still consults it behind a Skills-map guard invented locally; OpenMenus declared 'stable garbage' (main.go:3409) but still assembled every GetData; AvailableWaypoints dead but still populated. Every quarantine is a point-of-use convention a new behavior block can silently violate.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The redesign's foundation must be a typed perception layer with per-channel verdicts (live/dead/conditional + provenance + freshness) where dead channels are unrepresentable or return explicit errors — not a flat struct where garbage and truth have the same type.

rootDefects.defect: The d2go reader has no failure semantics: a missed signature returns 0 and the offset arithmetic continues, manufacturing plausible garbage that flows to consumers forever.
rootDefects.evidence: offset.go:21 'ignoring errors, always best practices'; FindPattern logs to stderr and returns 0; the five nightly PATTERN NOT FOUND warnings (GameData, Expansion, Roster, WidgetStates, Waypoints — 112 attaches in logs) produce garbage offsets through which getRoster and GetWidgetState still read every tick; Expansion's garbage silently selects the isMainPlayer fallback path that only accidentally works; GetData recomputes offsets only when UnitTable==0, no other miss is ever retried or reported upward.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The foundation reader must return per-offset resolution status at attach, refuse to serve channels whose offsets did not resolve, and surface that inventory to the layer above — pattern-miss-as-zero is the mechanism by which dead channels masquerade as live ones.

rootDefects.defect: Actuation primitives are ~15 closures inside main() with hand-choreographed stub state: every primitive individually remembers to moveStop(), override the right VK, sleep the right settle, and restore — mutual exclusion by convention.
rootDefects.evidence: walkToHold/moveStop/castSelf/interactClick/uiClick/hoverPickClick/interactNPC each open with moveStop() and their own Override/Restore pairs (main.go:519-830); the comment 'with the key held, ANY cursor aim would walk the character toward it' (main.go:597) names the failure mode a missed call produces; the signal-handler Unload races loop writes with zero synchronization (HANDOFF §7.4 — known, unfixed); vendor menus needed the same VK-override lesson re-learned independently (main.go:4949).
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: Input is a single shared state machine (held keys, patched exports, cursor ownership) and must have a single owner that serializes intents and guarantees restore — not N closures each holding a fragment of the protocol in their author's memory.

rootDefects.defect: Verification is a per-callsite habit, not the primitive's contract: hover-confirmed and blind actions coexist, and several 'verified' paths return success through meaningless branches.
rootDefects.evidence: meleeSwing/hoverAim are hover-confirmed (main.go:7956) but castSelf right-clicks blind (main.go:526), the curse cast fires blind (main.go:7889), and the rabies cast clicks a possibly-stale screen point (main.go:7937); hoverPickClick returns true three ways, only one meaningful (HANDOFF §9); interactNPC returns true on hovering ANY UnitType==5 including her own wolves and never checks a menu opened; -objects logged success for chests it never opened.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The stated law — silence is never success, HoverData is the only honest 'will this click hit' — must live in the actuation primitive's signature (act returns observed-effect-or-failure), so an unverified action is impossible to write, not merely frowned upon.

rootDefects.defect: Blocking cross-process calls sit in the primary actuation path: SendMessage-based clicks can hang the whole single-threaded bot against a frozen D2R while input patches are live.
rootDefects.evidence: MouseMoveClientSync was deleted specifically because 'SendMessage BLOCKS against a frozen/crashing D2R window, which is how farmbot hangs mid-run holding patches' (mouse.go:196-201) — yet Click, LeftClickNoMove, and LeftClickNoMoveClient still use win.SendMessage for button events (mouse.go:155, 170, 182); the ops layer compensates with timeout 960 reaping in overnight.sh, i.e. the architecture relies on an external kill of the exact kind ('never force-kill farmbot') the disciplines forbid.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: A perception/actuation foundation must bound every cross-process interaction in time; hang-on-freeze is structural, and the current mitigation (wrapper timeout) violates the project's own input-restore invariant when it fires.

rootDefects.defect: Cross-process stub ownership and the one-farmbot invariant are enforced by shell comments, not by construction.
rootDefects.evidence: The stubs live in D2R's user32 where 'a second farmbot instance, -fixinput's HealInput, a re-Load, or an aliased export can overwrite it without our knowledge' (memory_injector.go:117-123); the ONE-farmbot rule appears in HANDOFF_ORACLES.md §6 and overnight.sh's header, but no named mutex, lockfile, or stub ownership tag exists; stubIntact's read-back is a per-write repair, not an ownership protocol.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: Shared mutable code patches in another process are a distributed-systems problem; the redesign needs explicit ownership (single-instance lock plus stub provenance) so the safety property survives an operator who has not read two markdown files.

rootDefects.defect: Coordinate-space knowledge (five distinct spaces) is duplicated across files as measured comments on bare ints, with no type-level distinction.
rootDefects.evidence: World aim = logical client * dpiscale clamped (mouse.go:worldAimClient), panels = scaled origin + UNSCALED client (mouse.go:clientToPhysical + main.go aimPanel), lParam = client coords for panels but ignored by world (mouse.go:176-186), screenshots = physical pixels (screenshot.go:11-15), SendInput = 0..65535 normalized (sendinput.go). The DPI bug lived undetected 'for the entire life of the project' because sweep-based primitives succeed THROUGH mapping errors (HANDOFF §0.3); the -panelfn 'phys vs pos' experiment compared identical functions for a day.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: Every past aim catastrophe was a space-confusion bug; the foundation should encode spaces as distinct types with explicit, tested conversions so mixing them fails at compile time instead of after a night of soak.

rootDefects.defect: Measured laws live in commit messages and comments, not in a re-runnable conformance harness — nothing detects drift or re-derives constants on a new machine/build.
rootDefects.evidence: The oracles exist as one-off flags (-aimprobe, -wpcal, -movelab, -inputtest, -hookscan) that a human must remember to run; -dpiscale 1.25 is a hand-carried constant ('measured constants don't transfer between machines', HANDOFF_ORACLES §3); the -inputtest 'proof' was structurally incapable of falsifying its hypothesis (HANDOFF §0.1) and nothing prevents the next probe from shipping the same flaw; git log is explicitly 'the real lab notebook'.
rootDefects.whyArchitectural: The redesign's foundation layer should gate startup on a self-calibration suite (aim scale, hover round-trip, offset resolution, input-fn pristine check) so 'nothing above it may use an unproven primitive' is enforced at boot, every boot, instead of remembered.

keep: The GetPhysicalCursorPos stub aim primitive: install-once code, atomic 8-byte imm64 data writes on the hot path, stubIntact read-back before every partial write, never a cached installed flag (memory_injector.go)
The aliasing law and its handling: GetCursorPos == GetPhysicalCursorPos on this build — patch once, gate the legacy write on AliasesPhysicalCursorPos()
Resident keystate stubs with atomic compare-byte pokes, and the law that D2R POLLS GetKeyState — every click/key/menu input needs the override window
The key-down-edge stride discipline: release -> aim -> press per stride; force-move direction is sampled at the key-down edge only
walkToHold's continuous-keydown + dead-man timer, and Mover's progress clocks (5s physical stall / 12s closest-approach) — every walk journey owns a progress clock
hoverPickClick's aim -> settle -> re-aim -> re-confirm ritual against HoverData frame latency; HoverData.UnitID as the only honest click precondition — generalize to every interaction
The two measured coordinate formulas with their provenance: world = client*scale clamped in-window (off-window cursor discarded), panel physical = origin*scale + unscaled client
UIBytes 0xF4 menu-byte polling with a deadline, and the screenshot pixel oracles (panelLitRow blueness, bigLeftChange) as the court of appeal for dead UI channels
Mode-based death and gait detection; StatusGameGone asking the OS (GetExitCodeProcess) instead of inferring death from all-zero memory
The Skills-map gate on KeyBindings — believe a binding only when an independent live channel confirms the skill exists (the pattern for all cross-channel corroboration)
Atlas with sticky atlasRefused cells (actuation truth outranks the map prior, permanently), masked merging to streamed rooms, seed-keyed persistence
The live Room2 graph and the frontier-advance pattern for unstreamed borders; the 4-variant transpose scoring (>0.65 live agreement) before trusting any map grid
Seed-cached map fetch (refetch only on seed change)
HealInput pristine-bytes recovery from own user32 + verifyRestore + ResumeAllThreads; unconditional heal on Unload; -fixinput as the standalone repair
ScanInputHooks and diagnose.go (DiagnosePatterns/DumpModule) as read-only attach-time instrumentation — extend into the boot-gate conformance suite
The measured town-road waypoint encoding for fence-blind town navigation, and the static-click law fences (id=0 stairs never respond to synthetic clicks)
The esc-trap discipline: toggle panels with their own keys, never click pause-menu buttons synthetically
The falsifiability test from HANDOFF §0 as the acceptance bar for every future 'proven' claim
discard: -realcursor and -hwmove/Interception runtime paths reachable from walkToHold — they move real input, violate the aquarium constraint, and were already sentenced in HANDOFF §8; keep the driver code, if at all, in a separate lab binary
hwbp.go findWriter and the cursorscan write-drive era from the runtime binary — debugger-adjacent under an Arxan 'no debugger ever' law; the contradiction is unresolved and the tools are superseded
uiRightClick and every panel right-click path as anything but a quarantined lab verb — measured deaf under every override; the identify/shop flows already route around it
OverrideGetKeyboardState (zero callers, writes code into a live process) and the GetCursorInfo panel path once panelfn measurement is settled

Silent pattern-miss arithmetic in d2go calculateOffsets — replace FindPattern-returns-0 with per-offset resolution status; stop assembling Roster/WidgetStates/AvailableWaypoints/OpenMenus/KeyBindings into Data on a build where their offsets did not resolve
Blind cast call sites (castSelf, curse pass, rabies right-click) — replace with the verified-select + hover-or-effect-confirmed pattern the melee path already uses
SendMessage-based button delivery in the hot actuation path — replace with PostMessage or timeout-guarded calls so a frozen D2R cannot hang the bot holding patches
MovePointer's WM_SETCURSOR/WM_NCHITTEST magic-constant choreography for world use — restrict to menu interactions; world aim is AimPhysical only (competing-cursor drift is measured)

The ~15 input closures inside main() as the actuation API — fold into one input-authority object owning held-key state, stub ownership, and restore, with moveStop as an internal invariant rather than a callsite convention

Superseded probes whose coords disagree with the calibrated paths (-wptown, -wpat, -hoverprobe) and the vestigial left-click move fallback when -move is unset (already refused at startup for farm runs)
The one-farmbot-by-convention regime — replace with an OS-level single-instance lock plus stub-ownership check before any Override write
Trust in Object.Selectable and mapped exit positions without live corroboration — both measured liars on 3.2; entrance interaction must always run the contact-push + hover-spiral contract
